title: Khajuraho temples
summary: Khajuraho in India was the main seat of the Chandella rulers, who built many temples there; local tradition lists 85 and 25 survive. The ASI names the Lakshmana temple, built under Yasovarman in AD 954, as the earliest dated, and the Kandariya Mahadeva, its largest and grandest, as King Ganda's work of AD 1017–29. World History Encyclopedia gives c. 1025 under Vidyadhara.

uncertainty.note: Earliest dated temple AD 954 per the ASI; the Kandariya Mahadeva is AD 1017–29 (ASI) or around 1025 CE (WHE). End is the present: 25 temples survive.

when.display: earliest dated temple 954; Kandariya Mahadeva 1017–29; 25 survive

where.historical_name: Khajuraho, main seat of the Chandella rulers

reviewer_note: Group pin at the Kandariya Mahadeva (Western Group).
